description: The Water Rooster in Chinese astrology: personality, Water element traits, 1933 and 1993 dates and compatibility.
answer: In Chinese astrology, the Water Rooster is the Rooster born in a Water year, one of five versions of the tenth animal. It combines the Rooster's precision with Water's qualities. Water Rooster years between 1924 and 2044 are 1933 and 1993. The Rooster's fixed element is Metal.

sections.heading: The Water Rooster personality
paragraphs: Metal generates Water, and the Rooster carries Metal as its fixed element, so in a Water year the animal is said to pour its sharp intelligence into a stem of perception and communication. Water Roosters are often described as articulate, observant and intellectually curious, combining the sign's attention to detail with a deeper sensitivity to people. They tend to be good writers, teachers and analysts, able to explain complex ideas clearly. Their candour is usually gentler than other Roosters'. Because energy flows outward, they can overthink and over-explain, and readings mention a tendency to worry about details and to become caught up in analysis rather than action. Conversation is often their favourite pleasure.

In classical thought, Water belongs to the north and to the deep, resting energy of winter, the season when life gathers strength out of sight. As a year stem, it tends to make an animal more reflective, adaptable and emotionally attuned. People born under a Water stem are often described as clever negotiators, sensitive friends and natural mediators who prefer influence to force. They value understanding and tend to think before they act. The caution traditionally attached to Water is fluidity taken too far: avoiding conflict, keeping too much hidden and losing a clear sense of their own direction.

sections.heading: Water Rooster at work and in love
paragraphs: At work, Water is usually associated with communication, strategy and insight into people. Water-year people are often described as the ones who smooth negotiations, read what clients are really asking for and spot problems before they surface, which suits counselling, writing, diplomacy, research roles, marketing and the arts. They tend to adapt quickly to changing conditions. The traditional caution is a lack of firm boundaries: a Water stem may agree too readily, so clear goals and written commitments usually help it hold course.

Of all Roosters, the Water Rooster is usually considered the most communicative and intellectual. Publishing, policy analysis, translation, teaching and journalism are associated with it, as clarity and insight are rewarded in each. It enjoys organising ideas as much as objects, and it can explain a complicated subject so that everyone understands. In love, the Water Rooster is thoughtful, articulate and attentive, fond of long conversations over dinner. It needs intellectual companionship and someone who prizes candour. Over-analysis is its Achilles heel: it may dissect a partner's choices in detail or worry about small matters until a simple decision becomes complicated.

sections.heading: Water Rooster years and dates
paragraphs: Water Rooster years in the Lunar New Year table run from January 26, 1933 to February 13, 1934 and from January 23, 1993 to February 9, 1994. Because the year begins at Lunar New Year, a birthday in January or early February needs checking: in 1933 anyone born before Jan 26 is a Water Monkey, not a Water Rooster. Sixty years separate each Water Rooster year, the length of a full round of five elements and twelve animals. Every Water Rooster year is Yin, matching the Rooster's own polarity.

Its traditional name is Gui-You: Gui is the yin Water stem and You is the Rooster's branch. Births just before each new year fall in the Water Monkey year (before January 26, 1933) and the Water Monkey year (before January 23, 1993), and births in the weeks after each Water Rooster year ends belong to the Wood Dog. The new year itself fell on a Thursday in 1933 and Saturday in 1993.

sections.heading: Growth edges and compatibility for the Water Rooster
paragraphs: Acting before every detail is settled is the Water Rooster's most rewarding stretch. Setting a deadline for analysis, then committing, keeps their thoughtful minds from circling. Their sensitivity means they may take criticism more personally than they show; talking it through with a trusted friend restores perspective. Water Roosters often thrive in roles that use communication and insight, such as teaching, editing or counselling. Spending time near water or in quiet reflection calms their busy minds. When analysis serves decisive, compassionate action, Water Roosters become respected advisors and clear-sighted guides.

For relationships, the classical structures belong to the animal rather than the element, so the Water Rooster shares the Rooster's San He trine with the Ox and Snake (the Metal trine), its Liu He bond with the Dragon, and its Liu Chong clash with the Rabbit. The element adds a second layer: another Water sign shares this year element, while partners whose year element feeds Water in the generating cycle are often described as supportive.

faq.question: What years are Water Rooster years?
faq.answer: Between 1924 and 2044: 1933 (from January 26, 1933) and 1993 (from January 23, 1993). Each lasts until the day before the next Lunar New Year.

faq.question: What is the Water Rooster's element relationship?
faq.answer: The year element is Water and the Rooster's fixed element is Metal; in the five-element cycles metal generates Water. Readings use that relationship to describe how easily the two sides of the sign sit together.

faq.question: Which animals are most compatible with the Water Rooster?
faq.answer: Traditionally the Ox and Snake (San He) and the Dragon (Liu He). The Rabbit is the Liu Chong clash. These pairings depend on the animal, whatever the element.

faq.question: What is the Water Rooster called in the Chinese calendar?
faq.answer: Gui-You. In almanacs and Four Pillars charts each year is named by its heavenly stem, here the Water stem Gui, followed by its earthly branch, here You for the Rooster, so the name pins down both halves of the combination at once.

faq.question: How is the Water Rooster different from other Roosters?
faq.answer: All Roosters share precision, candour and diligence. The Water year element changes the tone: water is the element of winter, stillness and depth, and a Water year is traditionally said to give any animal intuition, flexibility and a gift for communication.
